From 650cede0415bad26f487c25e8eb3b39bfe04e740 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Nathan Chancellor <nathan@kernel.org>
Date: Thu, 28 Mar 2024 09:03:20 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] usb: typec: ptn36502: Only select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE with OF

CONFIG_DRM_AUX_BRIDGE depends on CONFIG_OF but that dependency is not
included when CONFIG_TYPEC_MUX_PTN36502 selects it, resulting in a
Kconfig warning when CONFIG_OF is disabled:

  WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for DRM_AUX_BRIDGE
    Depends on [n]: HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM_BRIDGE [=y] && OF [=n]
    Selected by [m]:
    - TYPEC_MUX_PTN36502 [=m] && USB_SUPPORT [=y] && TYPEC [=m] && I2C [=y] && (DRM [=y] || DRM [=y]=n) && DRM_BRIDGE [=y]

Only select CONFIG_DRM_AUX_BRIDGE when CONFIG_DRM_BRIDGE and CONFIG_OF
are enabled to clear up the warning. This results in no functional
change because prior to the refactoring that introduces this warning,
ptn36502_register_bridge() returned 0 when CONFIG_OF was disabled, which
continues to occur with drm_aux_bridge_register() when
CONFIG_DRM_AUX_BRIDGE is not enabled.

Fixes: 9dc28ea21eb4 ("usb: typec: ptn36502: switch to DRM_AUX_BRIDGE")
Signed-off-by: Nathan Chancellor <nathan@kernel.org>
Reviewed-by: Luca Weiss <luca.weiss@fairphone.com>
Reviewed-by: Heikki Krogerus <heikki.krogerus@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240328-fix-ptn36502-drm_aux_bridge-select-v1-1-85552117e26e@kernel.org
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240404123534.2708591-1-arnd@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/usb/typec/mux/Kconfig b/drivers/usb/typec/mux/Kconfig
index 4827e86fed6d..ce7db6ad3057 100644
--- a/drivers/usb/typec/mux/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/usb/typec/mux/Kconfig
@@ -60,7 +60,7 @@ config TYPEC_MUX_PTN36502
 	tristate "NXP PTN36502 Type-C redriver driver"
 	depends on I2C
 	depends on DRM || DRM=n
-	select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE if DRM_BRIDGE
+	select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE if DRM_BRIDGE && OF
 	select REGMAP_I2C
 	help
 	  Say Y or M if your system has a NXP PTN36502 Type-C redriver chip
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/usb/typec/mux/Kconfig`**
   - The line that selects `DRM_AUX_BRIDGE` has been modified:
     - **Before:** `select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE if DRM_BRIDGE`
     - **After:** `select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE if DRM_BRIDGE && OF`
   - This change ensures that `DRM_AUX_BRIDGE` is only selected when both `DRM_BRIDGE` and `OF` (Open Firmware) are enabled.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a Kconfig warning related to unmet dependencies for `DRM_AUX_BRIDGE`. By adding the condition for `OF`, the patch ensures that the selection of `DRM_AUX_BRIDGE` aligns with its dependencies, thus preventing the warning when `CONFIG_OF` is disabled.
- The functional behavior remains unchanged, as the previous implementation already resulted in `ptn36502_register_bridge()` returning 0 when `CONFIG_OF` was disabled. The new condition simply clarifies the dependency relationship without altering the existing functionality.

  WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for DRM_AUX_BRIDGE
    Depends on [n]: HAS_IOMEM [=y] && DRM_BRIDGE [=y] && OF [=n]
    Selected by [m]:
    - TYPEC_MUX_PTN36502 [=m] && USB_SUPPORT [=y] && TYPEC [=m] && I2C [=y] && (DRM [=y] || DRM [=y]=n) && DRM_BRIDGE [=y]

Only select CONFIG_DRM_AUX_BRIDGE when CONFIG_DRM_BRIDGE and CONFIG_OF

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the selection of `DRM_AUX_BRIDGE` in the Kconfig file without properly accounting for its dependency on `CONFIG_OF`. This led to a Kconfig warning about unmet dependencies when `CONFIG_OF` was disabled, as `DRM_AUX_BRIDGE` requires both `DRM_BRIDGE` and `OF` to be enabled. The previous selection logic did not enforce this requirement, resulting in potential misconfigurations.

Here is the patch:
 	depends on I2C
 	depends on DRM || DRM=n
-	select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE if DRM_BRIDGE
+	select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE if DRM_BRIDGE && OF
 	select REGMAP_I2C
 	help

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
+	select DRM_AUX_BRIDGE if DRM_BRIDGE && OF
```
Reason:
By modifying the selection to include the condition `&& OF`, the code now properly enforces the dependency on `CONFIG_OF`. This change ensures that `DRM_AUX_BRIDGE` is only selected when both `DRM_BRIDGE` and `OF` are enabled, thus eliminating the Kconfig warning and preventing potential misconfigurations.
